name: Zhenya Zakharova
source:
Zhenya Zakharova is a Ukrainian immigrant turned US Citizen who is on probation for 3 years for the crime of Theft by Receiving. She is also the owner and operator of Cheeki Breeki Bakery which has been accused of drug smuggling operations.
